bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the public policy text workflow and wrote regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs as an individual contribution to the team project.

Under supervision, compared dictionary coding with nonnegative-matrix-factorization topic exploration for public policy excerpts, examined stability across repeated fits, and inspected documents supporting each interpretation.
Under supervision, joined document identifiers to metadata using SQL, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons, and documented missing-data handling for the public policy excerpts.
As an individual contributor on a supervised research team, implemented reusable Python modules for the product review metadata workflow and wrote regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under supervision, validated SQL joins for product review metadata with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
